spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of ground against a plain off-white background. It has a low, arched quadrupedal body that is mostly covered dorsally in overlapping brown scales, with a pale pinkish-tan smooth-skinned head at the front bearing a blunt rounded snout and large dark eyes, six pink feathery external gills protruding from the neck just behind the head, four stout legs with scaly upper surfaces and pale wrinkled lower surfaces ending in clawed feet on the ground, and a thick tapering scaly tail extending to the left rear. The ventral area between the fore and hind legs shows pale, wrinkled, unscaled skin.

meta_spark.description: A stout quadrupedal creature shown in right profile walking to the right, with a highly arched back and body almost entirely covered in large overlapping brown pangolin-like scales from the top of the head down the back and onto the tail. The head is pale pink, smooth and axolotl-like with a broad blunt snout, large dark round eyes, and a wide slightly smiling mouth. Behind the head on both sides of the neck are multiple pink feathery external gills. The underside and parts of the legs show pale wrinkled bare skin. It stands on four short thick legs ending in pale clawed feet with dark claws, and has a long tapering scaly tail extending to the rear left.
